name: docs-workflows
description: Six commands for the documentation half of the dev-workflows pipeline. /docs-init scaffolds a documentation repository for a project that has none: a Material for MkDocs skeleton with public and internal builds over one content root, Vale, CI and a docs-profile.yml. /docs-brand extracts a logo and colour pair from the product's code and applies them, WCAG contrast-checked. /docs-serve runs the site's dev server. /document edits prose directly, or keyed to a PRD folder writes product docs from its implementation diffs behind an Opus review gate. /docs-profile refreshes a docs repository's machine-readable profile; /release-notes drafts a destination-shaped entry from the same folder. Eight agents and eighteen reference files carry repo resolution, diff summarising, planning, writing, scaffold review and style checks. Depends on workflows-core and prose-style.
